<style id="tll-photos-v3">/* tll-photos-v3 (13 Oct 2026). Page block for /share-photos, replaces <style id="tll-form-fix">. Draft only, never published by this stage.
   Every rule is scoped to .tll-photos-hero (section …8679), .tll-photos-section (section …8718), [data-tll-form=share-photos] (form …8710),
   .tll-photos-form (the FormWrapper …870f: counter reset, the .is-plain switch and the two Webflow boxes it holds) or, for row 30,
   [data-ms-content=anonymous] .tll-container (the signed-out gate). The class and id contract lives in contract.md next to this file.
   Tokens (proposal section 8): Paper #FDF9F3 page and inputs. Ink #0A0B14 text. Line #E0DACE borders. Cream #F7F1E8 dragover fill.
   Note tint #F0EBE0 success box. Rose text #C8325B title word, links, errors. Rose button #D63859 with white text, hover #C8325B.
   Teal #067A79 labels and checked states. Teal #00C9C8 focus halo. Drop-zone dash #A08A60. Glyph kraft #c9b89a. Muted #6B6660. Radius 4px everywhere.
   !important appears only where a site block already uses it on the same property (each one is listed in the build record). */

/* 1. One column: the hero loses its dark band, both sections lose their padding, the containers carry it. */
section.tll-section-dark.tll-photos-hero{background-color:#FDF9F3;background-image:none;color:#0A0B14;padding:0 !important}
section.tll-section.tll-photos-section{background-color:#FDF9F3;padding:0}
section.tll-photos-hero .tll-container{display:flow-root;width:100%;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:9vh 28px 0}
section.tll-photos-section .tll-container{display:flow-root;width:100%;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px 12vh}
.tll-photos-hero[data-tll-reveal],.tll-photos-section[data-tll-reveal]{transition-delay:0s}
.tll-photos-hero .tll-text-bone{color:#0A0B14}

/* 2. Hero type: back link, eyebrow, title, lede. */
.tll-photos-hero a.tll-eyebrow-teal{display:inline-block;min-height:24px;margin:0 0 16px;padding:0;color:#067A79 !important;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1.5px !important;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:3px}
.tll-photos-hero a.tll-eyebrow-teal:focus-visible{text-decoration:underline}
.tll-photos-hero div.tll-photos-eyebrow{margin:0 0 10px;padding:0;color:#067A79 !important;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase}
.tll-photos-hero h1.tll-photos-title{max-width:none;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0 0 4px;color:#0A0B14;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(34px,4.2vw,64px) !important;line-height:.95 !important;letter-spacing:-.025em !important;text-wrap:balance}
.tll-photos-hero h1.tll-photos-title em{color:#C8325B;font-style:italic}
.tll-photos-hero p.tll-photos-sub{max-width:56ch;margin:0 0 26px;color:#6B6660;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px !important;font-weight:400;line-height:1.55}

/* 3. The form: body type, counter, fieldset reset, group labels. */
.tll-photos-section .tll-photos-form{display:block;width:100%;margin:0}
.tll-photos-form form,[data-tll-form=share-photos]{counter-reset:tll-step;margin:0;color:#0A0B14;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] [hidden],[data-tll-form=share-photos] span.tll-pen-error[hidden],[data-tll-form=share-photos] ul.tll-photos-list[hidden]{display:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset{min-width:0;margin:0 0 18px;padding:0 !important;border:0 !important;border-radius:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-legend{float:none;display:block;width:auto;margin:0 0 8px;padding:0;color:#067A79;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-legend + *{clear:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] > fieldset > legend.tll-pen-legend::before,
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-promises > .tll-pen-legend::before,
[data-tll-form=share-photos] > fieldset > div.tll-pen-legend::before,
[data-tll-form=share-photos] > div.tll-pen-legend::before{counter-increment:tll-step;content:counter(tll-step,decimal-leading-zero) " · "}
[data-tll-form=share-photos].is-plain .tll-pen-legend::before,.tll-photos-form.is-plain .tll-pen-legend::before{content:none;counter-increment:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-help{margin:0 0 8px;padding:0;color:#6B6660;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-helptext{display:block;margin:0;color:#6B6660;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;line-height:1.5}

/* 4. Drop zone (label …8688) and the hidden file input (…8687). */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-photos-drop{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:30px;border:2px dashed #A08A60;border-radius:4px;background-color:#fff;background-image:none;color:#6B6660;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 150ms ease,background-color 150ms ease}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-photos-drop.is-dragover{border-color:#067A79;background-color:#F7F1E8}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-photos-drop.is-invalid,[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-photos-drop:has(> input[aria-invalid=true]){border-color:#C8325B}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-drop-icon{margin:0 0 8px;color:#c9b89a;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:300;line-height:1}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-drop-headline{margin:0 0 6px;color:#6B6660;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-drop-sub{max-width:400px;margin:0 0 6px;color:#6B6660;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-drop-hint{margin:0;color:#6B6660;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-photos-drop input.tll-photos-drop-input{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;min-height:0 !important;margin:-1px;padding:0 !important;border:0 !important;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-vh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;margin:-1px;padding:0;border:0;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}

/* 5. File list, count line, per-file errors (script-built, row 13). Rows enter with a 180ms rise and a 40ms stagger; removal is instant. The preview img fills the 64px tile (object-fit cover) and the tile clips it; without these two rules the img paints at its natural size. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] ul.tll-photos-list{display:grid;gap:6px;list-style:none;margin:10px 0 0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] li.tll-photos-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:66px;margin:0;padding:0 4px 0 0;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;animation:tll-photos-row-in 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--tll-i,0) * 40ms)}
@keyframes tll-photos-row-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-thumb{display:block;width:64px;height:64px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:3px 0 0 3px;background:#F7F1E8}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-thumb > img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-thumb.is-blank{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;padding:4px;color:#6B6660;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-name{overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:#0A0B14;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-size{color:#6B6660;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] button.tll-photos-remove{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:#C8325B;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] button.tll-photos-remove:focus-visible{text-decoration:underline}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] p.tll-photos-count{margin:8px 0 0;color:#6B6660;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-photos-file-errors{margin:0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] p.tll-photos-file-error{margin:6px 0 0;color:#C8325B;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}

/* 6. Fields: label above, 6px gap, Paper input with a Line edge, 4px radius, 48px tall, 16px type (16px stops iOS zooming on focus). */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;margin:0 0 16px}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:6px;margin:0 0 16px;padding:0;border:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-grid-2 > label.tll-pen-field{margin:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-label{display:block;margin:0;color:#0A0B14;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
/* tll-forms-v2 reaches the inputs through .w-input:not(…):not(…):not(…), specificity (0,4,0) with !important, so these selectors carry (0,4,2) and more. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-pen-field .tll-pen-input{display:block;width:100%;min-height:48px !important;margin:0;border:1px solid #E0DACE !important;border-radius:4px !important;background-color:#FDF9F3 !important;color:#0A0B14 !important;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif !important;font-size:16px !important;line-height:1.45 !important;box-shadow:none;transition:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-pen-field select.tll-pen-input{height:auto !important;min-height:48px !important;line-height:1.45 !important;background-color:#FDF9F3 !important;padding-right:44px !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-pen-field .tll-pen-input:focus{border-color:#E0DACE !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-pen-field .tll-pen-input[aria-invalid=true]{border:1.5px solid #C8325B !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-pen-field input[name=year].tll-pen-input{width:160px;max-width:100%}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel .tll-pen-legend{margin:0 0 6px;color:#0A0B14;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel .tll-pen-legend::before{content:none;counter-increment:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset{margin:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel .tll-pen-help{margin:0 0 10px}

/* 7. Inline errors (row 23): a Rose line right after the wrapping label, a Rose edge on the control or its card. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] span.tll-pen-error{display:block;margin:-10px 0 16px;color:#C8325B;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] span.tll-pen-error:empty{display:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-grid-2 > label.tll-pen-field + span.tll-pen-error{margin:-10px 0 0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-photos-drop + span.tll-pen-error{margin:8px 0 0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline + span.tll-pen-error{margin:-2px 0 10px}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] fieldset.tll-pen-fieldset label.tll-pen-field.is-invalid .tll-pen-input{border:1.5px solid #C8325B !important}

/* 8. Credit radios (row 19): three cards in a row, Ink edge on the checked one, credited-as line under the row. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-radios{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-radio{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:48px;margin:0;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:4px;background:#FDF9F3;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.3;cursor:pointer}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-radio:has(input:checked){border-color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-radio > span{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] p.tll-credited-as{margin:-8px 0 16px;color:#6B6660;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}

/* 9. Checkboxes and radios, native or Webflow custom: 20px, teal when checked, no halo on a mouse click. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] input[type=checkbox],[data-tll-form=share-photos] input[type=radio]{flex:none;width:20px !important;height:20px !important;min-width:20px;margin:0;accent-color:#067A79;cursor:pointer}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] input[type=radio]{border-radius:50%}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] input[type=checkbox]{border-radius:4px}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-checkbox-input,[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-radio-input{float:none;flex:none;width:20px !important;height:20px !important;margin:0 !important;border:1.5px solid rgba(10,11,20,.38) !important;background-color:#fff !important;transition:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-checkbox-input{border-radius:4px !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-checkbox-input.w--redirected-checked,[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-radio-input.w--redirected-checked{background-color:#067A79 !important;border-color:#067A79 !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-checkbox-input.w--redirected-focus,[data-tll-form=share-photos] .w-radio-input.w--redirected-focus{border-color:#0A0B14 !important;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #00C9C8 !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] input[type=checkbox]:focus:not(:focus-visible),[data-tll-form=share-photos] input[type=radio]:focus:not(:focus-visible),[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-actions input.tll-pen-submit:focus:not(:focus-visible){box-shadow:none !important;outline:none}

/* 10. Disclosures (rows 15 and 20): a text button with a ::after chevron (the script inserts no chevron element), a grid-row panel that opens over 200ms and closes in 150ms. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] button.tll-pen-disclosure{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:0 2px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:#067A79;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] button.tll-pen-disclosure::after{content:"";display:block;flex:none;width:7px;height:7px;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg);transform-origin:50% 50%;transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] button.tll-pen-disclosure[aria-expanded=true]::after{transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg);transition-duration:200ms}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] p.tll-pen-disclosure-help{margin:0 0 8px;color:#6B6660;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;margin:0;transition:grid-template-rows 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),visibility 0s linear 200ms}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr;visibility:visible;opacity:1;transition:grid-template-rows 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),visibility 0s}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel-inner{min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel-inner > :first-child{margin-top:14px}

/* 11. Where else it may appear (row 20): the old Syndication label becomes the help line, each row 44px with one label, second spans hidden. tll-pass-a gives .w-checkbox flex:0 0 auto, so the page lets it shrink (flex:1 1 auto, min-width:0) and the sentence wraps inside the column. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field:has(> .tll-pen-checkboxes) > .tll-pen-label,[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-panel > .tll-pen-panel-inner > label.tll-pen-field > .tll-pen-label{color:#6B6660;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field:has(> .tll-pen-checkboxes){gap:4px;margin:0 0 16px;cursor:default}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-checkboxes{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin:0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-checkbox{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:0;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-checkbox > .w-checkbox{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;width:auto !important;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-checkbox > .w-checkbox::before,[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-checkbox > .w-checkbox::after{display:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-checkbox .w-form-label{min-width:0;margin:0;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-checkbox > span:not(.w-form-label){display:none}

/* 12. Three promises (row 21): each row one Paper card, box top-aligned, bold first line, 13px explanation, Rose links. */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-promises{margin:14px 0 0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] p.tll-photos-summary{margin:0 0 10px;color:#6B6660;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:4px;min-height:44px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:4px;background:#FDF9F3;cursor:pointer}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline.is-invalid,[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline:has(input[aria-invalid=true]){border-color:#C8325B}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > .w-checkbox{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px;width:auto;min-height:0;margin:0;padding:0}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > .w-checkbox::before,[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > .w-checkbox::after{display:none}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > .w-checkbox > input,[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > .w-checkbox > .w-checkbox-input{margin-top:1px !important}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > .w-checkbox .w-form-label{display:block;margin:0;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline > span{display:block;margin:0 0 0 31px;color:#3a3a3a;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}
[data-tll-form=share-photos] label.tll-pen-field-inline a{color:#C8325B;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}

/* 13. Send (row 24), footnote (row 25), the two Webflow boxes (rows 26 and 27). tll-forms-v2 sizes the button through form input[type=submit].w-button, (0,2,2), so the page selector carries (0,3,1). */
[data-tll-form=share-photos] .tll-pen-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;margin:0;padding:0}

    /* 12 · rows 17, 23 and 25: inline errors with stable ids, the check in the capture phase, focus to the first failure,
       the count in the live region, errors cleared on input. noValidate only once the check is installed */
    try{
      var mkErr=function(key,input,label){ if(!input||!label) return; var s=el('span',{id:'tll-err-'+key,'class':'tll-pen-error',hidden:''}); after(label,s); errs[key]={s:s,i:input,l:label}; };
      mkErr('photos',photos,dropZone); mkErr('country',country,countryLabel); mkErr('year',year,yearLabel);
      mkErr('rights',rights,rightsLabel); mkErr('license',licence,licenceLabel); mkErr('people',people,peopleLabel);
      form.addEventListener('submit',function(ev){
        var fails=check(); live();
        if(!fails.length) return;
        ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
        var k=fails[0]; if(fails.indexOf('year')>=0&&detail){ detail.open(true); remember(); }   /* the year error sits inside the panel: open it whenever the year fails, wherever it falls in the list */
        try{ errs[k].i.focus(); }catch(e){}
      },true);
      form.addEventListener('input',onEdit); form.addEventListener('change',onEdit);
      form.noValidate=true;
    }catch(e){}
    function setErr(k,msg){ var e=errs[k]; if(!e) return false; e.s.textContent=msg; e.s.hidden=false; e.i.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true'); addRef(e.i,'aria-describedby',e.s.id); e.l.classList.add('is-invalid'); return true; }
    function clearErr(k){ var e=errs[k]; if(!e||e.s.hidden) return false; e.s.hidden=true; e.s.textContent=''; e.i.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'); dropRef(e.i,'aria-describedby',e.s.id); e.l.classList.remove('is-invalid'); return true; }
    function check(){
      var fails=[];
      function test(k,bad,msg){ if(!errs[k]) return; if(bad()){ setErr(k,msg); fails.push(k); } else clearErr(k); }
      test('photos',function(){ return !(photos.files&&photos.files.length); },'Add at least one photo.');
      test('country',function(){ return !val(country); },'Tell us the country, at least.');
      test('year',function(){ var y=val(year), lo=+year.getAttribute('min')||1990, hi=+year.getAttribute('max')||2030;
        return !!(year.validity&&year.validity.badInput)||(y&&!(/^\d{4}$/.test(y)&&+y>=lo&&+y<=hi)); },'A four-digit year. Guessing is allowed.');
      var tick='Tick this one to send.';
      test('rights',function(){ return !rights.checked; },tick); test('license',function(){ return !licence.checked; },tick); test('people',function(){ return !people.checked; },tick);
      return fails;
    }
    function live(){ if(!status) return; var n=0; for(var k in errs){ if(!errs[k].s.hidden) n++; } status.textContent=n?(n===1?'One thing to fix above.':n+' things to fix above.'):foot; }
    function onEdit(ev){
      var t=ev.target, cleared=false;
      for(var k in errs){ if(errs[k].i===t&&clearErr(k)) cleared=true; }
      if(cleared) live();
      if(t&&t.name==='credit-mode') showCredited();
      summary();
    }

    /* 13 · row 26: focus lands on the success box when Webflow shows it */
    try{
      var done=form.parentNode.querySelector('.w-form-done');
      done.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');
      var mo=new MutationObserver(function(){ if(getComputedStyle(done).display!=='none'){ mo.disconnect(); try{ done.focus(); }catch(e){} } });
      mo.observe(done,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style']});
    }catch(e){}

    /* 14 · rows 15 and 20: panels remembered for the session, and opened when a field inside already holds a value */
    try{
      var saved={}; try{ saved=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('tllPhotosPanels')||'{}')||{}; }catch(e){}
      var hasDetail=[city,year,pets].some(val)||!!(trip&&trip.selectedIndex>0&&trip.value);
      var hasShare=[social,rotation,press].some(function(i){ return i&&i.checked; });
      if(detail) detail.open(saved.detail||hasDetail);
      if(share) share.open(saved.share||hasShare);
    }catch(e){}
  }

  if(d.readyState==='loading') d.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run); else run();
})();
</script>
